theme.style: A calm clinical-paper world: warm quiet off-white grounds washed with mint #4CC9AB, blush #F5BCB5 and butter #FFE27C, anchored by deep forest #00211A for contrast. Soft daylight diffuses across matte paper grain, gentle cotton-like gradients and rounded organic shapes, like morning light on a bedside table. Nothing clinical-cold and nothing loud: airy, reassuring, humane, with generous negative space at the top for headlines.
